## Type of Change

## Checklist

- [ ] All commits contain `Signed-off-by:` tag (DCO)
- [ ] Code compiles without errors (`cargo check --workspace`)
- [ ] All tests pass (`cargo test --workspace`)
- [ ] Clippy passes (`cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Format is correct (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`)
- [ ] Error handling follows error-core conventions (use `error_core::helpers`)
- [ ] Changes align with project design philosophy: 0 randomness, 0 black-box inference
